about_short_description.short_description: FirstIgnite builds AI powered marketing software for universities

product.name: Autopilot
product.description: An AI-driven tool that automates prospecting by generating targeted company lists, identifying key contacts, summarizing research, and preparing market reports.

product.name: Mission Control
product.description: A research command center that consolidates grant data, research activities, faculty insights, and industry collaboration tools for a comprehensive campus research overview.

product.name: Match
product.description: An AI-powered matchmaking tool that identifies potential licensees, research partners, employers, and foundations by analyzing scientific texts and research outputs.

product.name: People Search
product.description: A tool that identifies key decision-makers at organizations by analyzing job descriptions, social profiles, and research histories to find verified contacts.

product.name: Email Outreach
product.description: An automated system that personalizes and sends emails to potential partners to initiate and drive collaboration.

product.name: Grant Finder
product.description: A tool that helps researchers identify funding opportunities by searching and filtering grants relevant to their projects.
